# george — work list

One static binary, one local model, four MCP children, stdin/stdout. An
item is done when its check passes. Writing the code is not enough.

## Work list

- [ ] **Full gate at `-eval.n=5`, every fixture 5/5**, on named server
  versions. The number to beat is 49 of 55.
- [ ] **Pin the graded servers.** `download_tag = "latest"` in the manifest
  and `download.go` checks no checksum. Pin each tag and verify each
  archive against its release `checksums.txt`.
- [ ] **Input history.** Arrow-key recall across messages on the terminal.
  `x/term` has none; this is the one place a line-editor import earns its
  place. Check: Up at the prompt recalls the last message.

## Not doing

Recorded so the next pass does not retry them.

- Abstract contract lines (least change as a principle, KISS, DRY). Two
  rewrites scored 0/10; concrete lines with a tool name are what move
  this model.
- A summarizer completion, a tool-shim model, a second provider, a
  sandbox, an approval prompt. The design non-goals stand.
- Whole-file write through `file_patch` with no `old`. The refusal is
  right; it lost a test once.
- [ ] **`george self-update` command.** Fetch the latest GitHub release, compare its tag to the running binary's version, download the asset for this OS/arch, and replace the executable. Require `GITHUB_TOKEN` when the unauthenticated API rate-limits.
- Shell as the default write path. See design.md.
